caption: The drawing features a single metallic object rendered in shades of gray and black against a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a long, pointed spike extending horizontally to the left, attached to a cylindrical central section with jagged edges on top, resembling a serrated ring. From this central part, a curved, hook-like element rises vertically, arching to the right. Extending from the same central section in the opposite direction from the spike is an elongated flat handle ending in a large, oval-shaped loop. The shapes and shadows are detailed, providing a sense of three-dimensionality. The artist's signature, "B. Pomer," is present in small script in the lower left corner.
title: Miner's Candlestick
